name: implement-merge
description: Plan-to-merge execution loop with nested caller-owned goals and explicit rebuild policies.

interface.shortDescription: Implement plans through merged PR phases.
interface.longDescription: Plan-to-merge execution loop. Clears stale context, implements bounded phases, delivers each through pr-delivery, and supports caller-owned goals with rebuild, defer, or never policies.
defaultPrompt: Use $implement-merge to implement and merge the most recent plan.
Find the newest plan, reset context between PR phases, deliver each phase with $pr-delivery, then rebuild already-running containers.
Execute a caller-owned plan with an explicit rebuild policy.
